Story: Fact Sheet: Synthetic tariffs on imported widgets
What this is: the text of 2 publications, as this server retrieved them from the publisher's own page.
The shared brief of this story is not included: an analysis reads the reports themselves.
Only the reports' own words can be quoted as evidence: each headline, feed excerpt and publication text below. These opening lines, the labels of each report (such as "Publisher:" or "Headline:") and any note in square brackets are Second Order's, not a publisher's, and a quote from them is not accepted.

Report 1 of 2
Publisher: The White House
Published (as the feed states it): Wed, 14 Oct 2026 06:00:00 GMT
Address: https://www.whitehouse.gov/fact-sheets/2026/10/synthetic-tariff-fact-sheet/
Headline: Fact Sheet: Synthetic tariffs on imported widgets
Text of the publication (retrieved 2026-10-14 09:00 UTC from https://www.whitehouse.gov/fact-sheets/2026/10/synthetic-tariff-fact-sheet/):
SYNTHETIC: Today the President signed a proclamation imposing a 12% tariff on imported widgets, effective November 1, 2026. It applies to widgets from every country except two partners named in an annex.

SYNTHETIC: The annex lists the two partners.

- SYNTHETIC first point of the fact sheet.

- SYNTHETIC second point, with emphasis.
Credit: The White House

Report 2 of 2
Publisher: The White House
Published (as the feed states it): Wed, 14 Oct 2026 07:00:00 GMT
Address: https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2026/10/synthetic-tariff-proclamation/
Headline: SYNTHETIC: Imposing tariffs on imported widgets
Text of the publication (retrieved 2026-10-14 09:00 UTC from https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2026/10/synthetic-tariff-proclamation/):
SYNTHETIC: BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA. A PROCLAMATION. 1. Imports of widgets threaten to impair the national security, as the Secretary reported. 2. A duty of 12% applies from November 1, 2026.

- SYNTHETIC first point of the fact sheet.

- SYNTHETIC second point, with emphasis.
Credit: The White House
